title: gohard.yaml
description: GoHard project configuration (#28). Generated by tools/genconfig; do not edit.

standard.description: The VHDL standard files are analyzed under. It must be a quoted string: `standard: "2008"`.

lenient.description: Relax analysis rules that other VHDL tools commonly relax. Under `lenient: true`: from VHDL-2002 on a shared variable need not be of a protected type, reported as a `sema/relaxed` warning (GHDL `-frelaxed`, NVC `--relaxed`); a subprogram body may add or omit `constant` on a parameter that names no mode (GHDL `-frelaxed`, NVC `--relaxed`); a subelement of a formal associated individually may be associated with `open` (GHDL `-frelaxed`, NVC `--relaxed`); a pure function may declare a file (GHDL `-frelaxed`, NVC `--relaxed`) and name an external signal or variable (GHDL `-frelaxed`); an `others` aggregate assigned to an unconstrained port, parameter or alias takes the target's index range (GHDL `-frelaxed`, NVC `--relaxed`); a name used in its own declaration denotes the outer homograph (NVC `--relaxed`; GHDL accepts it with a `-Whide` warning in every mode); an alias of a subprogram or enumeration literal may omit the signature and denotes the first visible one (NVC in every mode; GHDL always requires the signature); a component instantiation may name an entity without the reserved word `entity` (neither GHDL nor NVC accepts this). Only the shared variable rule is reported; the others are accepted silently.

comments.description: Parse `-- psl` comment lines as PSL.

strict_keywords.description: Report PSL-only words used as identifiers as errors (GHDL-style).

libraries.description: Maps each library name to the folders holding its sources, relative to the project root. Files in no listed folder go to `work`. A missing or unreadable folder is a setup error (exit 2).

allow_opaque.description: Encrypted units that may stay opaque. It downgrades encrypted IP only; unsupported constructs stay exit 2. `gohard libs detect --write` fills it in.

defines.description: User conditional-analysis identifiers. `--define NAME=VALUE` overrides an entry with the same name. Defining a built-in identifier (`VHDL_VERSION`, `TOOL_TYPE`, `TOOL_VENDOR`, `TOOL_NAME`, `TOOL_EDITION`, `TOOL_VERSION`) is a setup error (exit 2).

align_ports.description: Align port, generic and association lists.

max_line_length.description: Lines longer than this are wrapped.

unused_signal.description: A signal never read or never assigned, an in port never read, an out port never assigned (`lint/unused-signal`).

auto_run_on_save.description: When on, testbench candidates whose dependencies changed run after a short debounce on save. The code lens and the CLI always run.

testbenches.description: Entities to treat as testbenches, in addition to every entity without ports.

seed.description: The simulation seed: it fixes the in-delta process order. 0 keeps declaration order.

time_budget.description: Simulated time after which a run stops with `sim/budget-exceeded`.

delta_budget.description: Delta cycles allowed per time step.

stop_level.description: The assertion severity that stops a run. It does not change severities or exit codes.

dump_scope.description: Only signals under these instance paths are traced. Empty traces every signal. Traces always go to `.gohard/traces/`.

models.description: Maps an opaque unit to the user's own plain VHDL model. GoHard checks that the stand-in's ports match the real component's.

epoch.description: The wall-clock time of simulated time 0: `EPOCH`, `GMTIME` and `LOCALTIME` report it plus the simulated time, in UTC, unless `--real-env` is given (in effect since v1.1).

vars.description: The only variables `GETENV` sees (in effect since v1.1); `--env NAME=VALUE` overrides an entry. `--real-env` reads the real environment instead.
